content.premise: The party walk into Kelderby on the afternoon of the Founders' Play, are taken by the innkeeper for the travelling troupe she hired, and have until sunset to find the town its Dragon, its Founder and its Loaf.
content.theme: A cheerful harbour town on the slope below a castle mountain, on the afternoon of its yearly Founders' Play: one main street from the cathedral square down to the quays, side streets off it, a lighthouse on the headland, the castle up its long road.
content.title: Curtain Up in Kelderby
